description:
Process is as below
1. HR team will fill initial information about the candidate like Name, Gender, Country, Designations, emailID, status like [Link Generate, Link Open, DataSubmitted, Review, Confirmed], status date. 
2. It should have a button to send link to candidate over email to candidate with a key. 
3. Key will have a life for say 1 day [Should be configurable]. 
4. Link will contain the URL of the form which will be embedded inside application. 
5. Stauts should be changed to ‘Link Generated’, Status date should be updated.
6. Application will validate the key, if key is valid then only it should open the application. 
7. Status should be changed to ‘Link Accessed’, Status date should be updated.
8. Candidate should fill the required fields like EMP_FNAME,EMP_MNAME,EMP_LNAME,NAME_PREFIX, Gender, Current Address, Current PIN, Current CITY, CURRENT STATE, Mobile, Alternate Telephone, Permanent Address, Permanent PIN, Permanent CITY, Permanent STATE, NATIONALITY, BIRTHDATE, MARITAL STATUS, MARRIAGE ANNIVERSARY, BLOOD GROUP, Contact Person, Contact Person Mobile, Contact person Email, Religion, Bank Account No, Bank IFSC Code, Bank Name, Total Experience, PF NO, ESIC NO, HOBBY1, HOBBY2, PASSPORT_NO, PAN_NO, AADHAR_NO, DRIVING LIC NO, PHYSICAL_HANDICAP, MOTHER_TONGUE, CAST_CATEGORY, 
9. Form Should have option to validate the PAN_NO, AADHAR_NO, BANK_DETAIL, It shoudl call IOFLOW API to validate, Allow only 3 try. It shoudl also store the status of these requests Validated True or False with Name returned
10. It should also allow Candidate to attach Image/File for PAN_NO, AADHAR_NO, Bank Account No [Should attach image of crossed Cheque or Passbook].
11. It Should have a detail table like form where Candidate can enter multiple rows for his 'Past Experince', it should have field like [LINE_NO, ORGANISATION, DESIGNATION, FROM_DATE, TO_DATE, GROSS_AMT, GROSS_AMT, COUNTRY_CODE]
12. It Should have a detail table like form where Candidate can enter multiple rows for his 'Educational Qualification', it should have field like [LINE_NO, QLF_CODE, QLF_TYPE, INSTITUTE, PASS_YEAR, CLASS, PERCENTAGE, COUNTRY_CODE, COURSE_TYPE, COURSE_DURATION]
13. It Should have a detail table like form where Candidate can enter multiple rows for his ‘FAMILY', it should have field like [LINE_NO, MEMBER_NAME, DATE_BIRTH, GENDER, RELATION]
14. Candidate Can have Save and Submit 2 options. 
15. Candidate Can edit the detail till he 'Submit’. 
16. Once Submitted Candidate cannot open link. 
17. On Submission it should intimate the HR person who initiated the link. 
18. On Submission an email will be sent to Candidate with all informations Candidate filled on the form. 
19. Status should be changed to ‘DataSubmitted’, Status date should be updated.
20. Now, HR Person Can Open the transaction and check the data submitted. Can Re-Check the AN_NO, AADHAR_NO, BANK_DETAIL via IOFLOW if needed.
21. HR Person can further update following EMP_CODE, DESIGNATION, DEPT_CODE, GRADE, CADRE, DESIGN_CODE, REPORT_TO, JOINED_AS, DATE_JOIN, WORK_SHIFT, HOL_TBLNO, EMP_SITE, PAY_SITE, BASIC, GROSS, PROBATION_DATE, PROBATION_PRD, NOTICE_PRD, EMAIL_ID_OFF, REPORT_TO__ADMIN, USER_ID, REMARKS, 
22. HR PERSON Should have a detail table like form where can enter multiple rows for his ‘CANDIDATE_PAY', it should have field like [LINE_NO, AD_CODE, AMOUNT, AMOUNT_TYPE, FREQUENCY, RES_FORMULA, AMOUNT_CALC, UPD_PAYSTRU, APPL_MODE]
23. ON CONFIRMATION IT SHOULD CALL IOFLOW API FOR EMPLOYEE
